top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 incretin award is mature, transformative and clinically proven in type 2 diabetes and obesity. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov each made distinct, foundational contributions: GLP-1 physiology and gut-hormone biology, and the identification of the active peptide form. The citation scope is well defined and the three-laureate allocation is defensible, so awarding it is clearly preferable to no award.
